And so that's the basic idea that we're going to try to wrap our heads around with this idea of יחיד. אך מה שאמרו חכים ולא בחכמה ידיעה, so this that we say that God is wise, but not with a knowable wisdom, so in other words, until now this past little section was focusing on the transcendent aspect of it, the unknowable essence that transcends any definition. And then the other side of that, the fact that we say, well, even in the level of יחיד we can say that God has חכמה and בינה, but it's just wise, but not with a knowable wisdom, etc., שיש על כל פנים חילוקי מדרגות חכם ומבין חסד ורחמים וכולי, that seems to imply that there is there are these meaningful definitions and distinctions between God being wise and God being understanding and God being kind and God being merciful. הכל לא מצד עצמותו, all of those distinctions are not distinctions that exist from the perspective of His essence. רק מצד מה ששער בעצמו בכח מה שעתיד להיות בפועל אחר הצמצום הראשון הנ''ל, it's only from the perspective that since God created the world, so that means that He like we're kind of looking back and saying, well, God created a world where there are these different attributes, so that means that He must have chose in His essence to invent the idea of חכמה and invent the idea of בינה and invent the idea of חסד and רחמים and all of these kind of things. And so therefore they must come from Him, and so looking back, we say these things that we now see as separate from after the צמצום, within the סדר השתלשלות, each of those are really rooted in God's essence, but from the perspective of God's essence where they're coming from, there's no real distinction between them, it's just He can choose to create whatever He wants, and there's no difference to Him between creating חכמה or בינה or חסד or גבורה, any of these things. וכמו שמבואר במקום אחר בלשון האריז''ל עצמו מבואר במקום אחר באריכות, like it's explained, I'm sorry, like it explains in the מקדש מלך, in the ספר מקדש מלך, which is quoting the אריז''ל about this, and like it's explained elsewhere at length in the works of חסידות. וזהו ענין כללות המאמר הראשון שבזהר, and this is the meaning of the the first teaching in the זוהר. Now, in the original versions of the זוהר, this was actually the first page of the זוהר. In our versions of the זוהר, this begins on page 15, ט''ו, where it starts פרשת בראשית, but before that there's like an introduction that's, you know, a 14-page introduction of other ideas. So, I'm not positive which version of the זוהר the מיטעלער רבי was using, but either way this is definitely the beginning of ספר בראשית after the introduction. And so there the first teaching is that it says בראשית, in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth, so it explains what is this idea. Let me just pull up this זוהר here. So, it says here, so it says בראשית, in the beginning, and so the זוהר explains, בריש הורמנותא, here it says הורמנותא, there's different slight different versions of it, but here our the the מיטעלער רבי has הורמנא, בריש הורמנא דמלכא, in the beginning of the desire of the King, גליף גליפי, He engraved or some have versions have like here גליפו, He engraved an engraving, or it was engraved, בטהירו עילאה, in upper purity, בוצינא דקרדינותא, with this dark spark or dark candle. So, God first engraved this, you know, dark point, ונפק גו סתים דסתימו מרישא דאין סוף קוטרא בגולמא, so God brought out this hidden point from the beginning of the אין סוף, and He emanated this line of light into the this sphere of the world, נעוץ בעזקא לא חיורא ולא אוכמא ולא סומקא ולא ירוק ולא גוון כלל, and He emanated this from this most concealed place, and it was a this shapeless form, and then He put in the center of this sphere, and it wasn't white, it wasn't black, it wasn't green, it didn't have any color at all. And then it goes on to say how from there He emanated all different colors and everything like that, and this became the source of everything. So that's the first it's describing the beginning of creation. And so the idea there that it says, in the beginning of the will of the King, that He engraved an engraving in the upper purity, פירוש בעצמות גילוי אור הפשוט, meaning that that within this essential, simple light of God's essence, right? So God has within Himself this idea of His self-expression that He can do anything and He can just show and express that He can do anything. הנל שנקרא טהירו עילאה, which is called the upper purity, so in that level, גליף גליפו שהוא ענין חקיקת אותיות, He engraved an engraving, which is the idea of forming letters, and a letter is the idea of like a limited revelation that has a certain form. And ובריש הורמנותא, the beginning of His desire, שזה כשעלה ברצונו הפשוט, that's when it arose in His simple will, שהוא בחינת כתר, that's the, so that's arising in His will, that's the כתר of the אין סוף, ובחינת האות שחקק הוא בחינת המלכות דאין סוף, and those letters that He engraved, where He, so to speak, like chose a form that He was going to reveal Himself in, that is the idea of the מלכות of the אור אין סוף. And so we see the זוהר is already alluding to this idea that there's this simple unity, but in that simple unity God revealed this idea of a כתר and then the all the way down to מלכות. ואם כן יש ראש וסוף כתר ומלכות גם בבחינת עצמיות אור אין סוף, and so we see that there's this idea of a beginning and an end, a כתר and a מלכות, even within the עצמיות, even in the essence of the infinite light. So this is the idea that we need to understand, on the one hand to appreciate the transcendent nature of God's essence, and in general to understand this relationship of a transcendent essence and how that transcendent essence can include within itself and be the source of diverse expressions, and yet that essence remains transcendent and the same, and so from the perspective of that essence nothing is changing, and yet it's expressed in many ways. And we're going to talk about how it's expressed in these ten ספירות, because that's what we relate to as humans that are built with this kind of ten attributes.
